title: Five More Pieces, Six More Words
label: ch:bn-pieces-into-words
canDo: I can read six Bengali words I already say — নাম, আমি, লাল, তিন, তুমি and কেমন — by adding five pieces to the nine I already write, and I can say why a vowel sign written in front of a consonant is still spoken after it.

payoff.summary: The six words of the chapter read back in one pass, introducing no new shape — and the count that shows why three of the five additions being vowel signs was worth more than three more consonants.
